about: The Overview's blocks on the console and in `faxbot overview`, from the same answers. `base` is a healthy, established installation (a trimmed copy of capabilities.json); each scenario replaces some answers. dashboard.test.tsx renders the console from it; api/tests/test_cli_overview.py runs the command on it.

body.title: Capabilities
body.sentence: Everything Faxbot can do to make your faxes cost less and take less time, grouped by what it helps with.

legend.label: On or Off
legend.sentence: Whether it is switched on for your faxes.

legend.label: Works here or Not here
legend.sentence: Whether this installation has what it needs, such as its own phone line or a partner.

legend.label: Live call, Test lab or Sample data
legend.sentence: How far Faxbot has proven it: on a live carrier call, in its own test lab, or with sample data only.

filters.label: On
filters.sentence: Switched on for your faxes.

filters.label: Off
filters.sentence: Switched off for now.

filters.label: Ready to turn on
filters.sentence: Off, but this installation already has what it needs.

filters.label: Needs something
filters.sentence: Missing something it needs, such as a connection, prices or a recipient's agreement.

filters.label: Experimental
filters.sentence: Still being proven; its evidence and limits are shown with it.

outcomes.title: Spend less on sending
outcomes.sentence: Choose the route, plan or number that costs least for each fax.

capabilities.name: Cheapest route per delivered fax
capabilities.sentence: Sends each number by the route that cost least per delivered fax once two routes have proven themselves.
capabilities.example: Faxes to a busy clinic went through two routes last month. Faxbot now sends that number by the route that cost less per delivered fax, counting the tries that failed.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On; a preferred route for a number still comes first.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a second sending route to compare with; you send through Telnyx only.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: A second sending route, such as another fax service account or your own SIP trunk.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: Prices for at least two sending routes that charge for each fax.

outcomes.title: Smaller documents and shorter calls
outcomes.sentence: Send fewer pages, and keep each page on the line for less time.

capabilities.name: Encoded pages (experimental)
capabilities.sentence: Sends a whole document as a few dense fax pages that the recipient's Faxbot turns back into the original, for recipients who agreed.
capabilities.example: A long report goes as a few dense fax pages to a recipient that runs Faxbot and agreed, and the recipient's Faxbot turns them back into the exact original file.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: No recipient has agreed to encoded pages yet.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A fax service account or your own SIP trunk that sends faxes.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: A recipient that runs Faxbot and agrees to encoded pages; you record that on their page.

capabilities.name: Lighter shading
capabilities.sentence: Lightens shaded areas and removes specks before a page goes on a line billed by time, so pages take less time to send.
capabilities.example: A scanned form with grey shading goes over a line billed by the minute. The shading is lightened and specks removed first, so each page takes fewer seconds to send.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A fax service account or your own SIP trunk that sends faxes.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A sending route billed by the minute or second, such as your own SIP trunk.

capabilities.name: Fax over IP (T.38)
capabilities.sentence: Carries fax pages as data over your SIP trunk, so pages go through faster than audio fax and calls are shorter.
capabilities.example: A ten-page fax over your SIP trunk goes as fax data (T.38) instead of audio, so the call takes less time.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Your own SIP trunk, from a phone carrier or your phone system.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A network and carrier that carry T.38. Faxbot checks this itself and switches T.38 back on when they do.

capabilities.name: Faster pages
capabilities.sentence: Sends pages over SSL Fax when the other fax machine offers it, so calls take less time.
capabilities.example: When the receiving fax server offers SSL Fax, the pages go over an encrypted internet connection during the call instead of as audio, so the call ends sooner.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs Faxbot's fax engine, which starts when you select Apply and connect on the trunk page.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Your own SIP trunk for sending, from a phone carrier or your phone system.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: Faxbot's fax engine, which starts when you select Apply and connect on the trunk page.

outcomes.title: Avoid repeated calls and documents
outcomes.sentence: Send what a recipient already has only once, and share calls where recipients agree.

capabilities.name: Case packets
capabilities.sentence: Leaves documents a recipient already accepted out of a case packet, so fewer pages are sent.
capabilities.example: A clinic sends a referral packet to the same specialist every month. The specialist already confirmed the insurance card and consent form, so the packet lists them instead of faxing those pages again.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: No recipient accepts a list of the documents they already have yet.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A fax service account or your own SIP trunk that sends faxes.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: The recipient accepts a list of the documents they already have; you record that on their page.

capabilities.name: Direct delivery
capabilities.sentence: Sends documents to verified partners over the internet instead of placing a fax call.
capabilities.example: A hospital that also runs Faxbot is your verified partner. A discharge summary to its fax number goes over the internet as the original file, with no fax call.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: A verified partner: another organization that runs Faxbot, added from its partner card and confirmed with a check fax.

capabilities.name: Sending together
capabilities.sentence: Sends several short faxes to the same number in one call, on a line that charges for each call.
capabilities.example: Five short faxes for the same lab within a few minutes go in one call instead of five, on a trunk that charges for each call.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On for 1 recipient who agreed.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Your own SIP trunk for sending, from a phone carrier or your phone system.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Trunk prices that charge for each call or bill whole minutes, so one call for several faxes costs less.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A recipient that agrees to receive several faxes in one call; you record that on their page.

capabilities.name: Fewer separator pages
capabilities.sentence: Marks each document in a shared call with an index page or a line on each page instead of a separator page.
capabilities.example: Three documents sent together to a lab start with one index page that lists them, instead of a separator page before each one.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: No recipient has agreed to an index page or page marks yet.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Your own SIP trunk for sending, from a phone carrier or your phone system.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Trunk prices that charge for each call or bill whole minutes, so one call for several faxes costs less.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: A recipient that shares calls and agrees to an index page or page marks; you record that on their page.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: For marks at the top of every page: your header text and sending number.

outcomes.title: Lower receiving and service costs
outcomes.sentence: Keep only the numbers, lines and plans you need, and turn away junk calls.

capabilities.name: Junk callers turned away
capabilities.sentence: Declines calls from blocked numbers before Faxbot answers, so they are never answered or received.
capabilities.example: A number keeps sending junk faxes at night. Once you block it, its calls are declined before Faxbot answers, so nothing is received or stored.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On for 1 number on your blocked list.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Faxes received over your own SIP trunk.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A number on your blocked list.

body.sentence: Each figure is an estimate: what you paid compared with what the same faxes would have cost the usual way.
body.total_sentence: About $1.25 saved in the last 30 days.

sending_together.sentence: 3 faxes to 1 number went in 1 call: 2 calls and about $0.40 saved.

case_packets.sentence: 2 case packets left out 3 documents the recipient already had: 12 pages and about $0.60 saved.

sslfax.sentence: 4 faxes went over SSL Fax: 95 seconds and about $0.25 saved.

direct_delivery.sentence: No documents went straight to a partner in the last 30 days.

direct_bytes.sentence: 2.4 MB not sent again: 1 reference and 1 set of changes.

items.sentence: Faxes to Synthetic Lab cost about $0.03 less each through Telnyx than through Phaxio.

body.sentence: Establishing one fact would have made faxes to 1 recipient cheaper or priced over the last 90 days.

recipients.name: County Records
recipients.sentence: 4 faxes to County Records have no price yet.

facts.title: No price for the route these faxes took
facts.confirm: Your Phaxio account shows what it charges for each page.
facts.step: Enter the price under Savings & optimization → Prices & plans.
facts.sentence: 4 faxes have no price, so Faxbot cannot compare routes for them.

body.realized: These figures are what your faxes would have cost, not savings.

body.title: Capabilities
body.sentence: Everything Faxbot can do to make your faxes cost less and take less time, grouped by what it helps with.

legend.label: On or Off
legend.sentence: Whether it is switched on for your faxes.

legend.label: Works here or Not here
legend.sentence: Whether this installation has what it needs, such as its own phone line or a partner.

legend.label: Live call, Test lab or Sample data
legend.sentence: How far Faxbot has proven it: on a live carrier call, in its own test lab, or with sample data only.

filters.label: On
filters.sentence: Switched on for your faxes.

filters.label: Off
filters.sentence: Switched off for now.

filters.label: Ready to turn on
filters.sentence: Off, but this installation already has what it needs.

filters.label: Needs something
filters.sentence: Missing something it needs, such as a connection, prices or a recipient's agreement.

filters.label: Experimental
filters.sentence: Still being proven; its evidence and limits are shown with it.

outcomes.title: Spend less on sending
outcomes.sentence: Choose the route, plan or number that costs least for each fax.

capabilities.name: Cheapest route per delivered fax
capabilities.sentence: Sends each number by the route that cost least per delivered fax once two routes have proven themselves.
capabilities.example: Faxes to a busy clinic went through two routes last month. Faxbot now sends that number by the route that cost less per delivered fax, counting the tries that failed.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On; a preferred route for a number still comes first.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a second sending route to compare with; you send through Telnyx only.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: A second sending route, such as another fax service account or your own SIP trunk.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: Prices for at least two sending routes that charge for each fax.

outcomes.title: Smaller documents and shorter calls
outcomes.sentence: Send fewer pages, and keep each page on the line for less time.

capabilities.name: Encoded pages (experimental)
capabilities.sentence: Sends a whole document as a few dense fax pages that the recipient's Faxbot turns back into the original, for recipients who agreed.
capabilities.example: A long report goes as a few dense fax pages to a recipient that runs Faxbot and agreed, and the recipient's Faxbot turns them back into the exact original file.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: No recipient has agreed to encoded pages yet.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A fax service account or your own SIP trunk that sends faxes.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: A recipient that runs Faxbot and agrees to encoded pages; you record that on their page.

capabilities.name: Lighter shading
capabilities.sentence: Lightens shaded areas and removes specks before a page goes on a line billed by time, so pages take less time to send.
capabilities.example: A scanned form with grey shading goes over a line billed by the minute. The shading is lightened and specks removed first, so each page takes fewer seconds to send.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A fax service account or your own SIP trunk that sends faxes.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A sending route billed by the minute or second, such as your own SIP trunk.

capabilities.name: Fax over IP (T.38)
capabilities.sentence: Carries fax pages as data over your SIP trunk, so pages go through faster than audio fax and calls are shorter.
capabilities.example: A ten-page fax over your SIP trunk goes as fax data (T.38) instead of audio, so the call takes less time.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Your own SIP trunk, from a phone carrier or your phone system.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A network and carrier that carry T.38. Faxbot checks this itself and switches T.38 back on when they do.

capabilities.name: Faster pages
capabilities.sentence: Sends pages over SSL Fax when the other fax machine offers it, so calls take less time.
capabilities.example: When the receiving fax server offers SSL Fax, the pages go over an encrypted internet connection during the call instead of as audio, so the call ends sooner.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs Faxbot's fax engine, which starts when you select Apply and connect on the trunk page.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Your own SIP trunk for sending, from a phone carrier or your phone system.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: Faxbot's fax engine, which starts when you select Apply and connect on the trunk page.

outcomes.title: Avoid repeated calls and documents
outcomes.sentence: Send what a recipient already has only once, and share calls where recipients agree.

capabilities.name: Case packets
capabilities.sentence: Leaves documents a recipient already accepted out of a case packet, so fewer pages are sent.
capabilities.example: A clinic sends a referral packet to the same specialist every month. The specialist already confirmed the insurance card and consent form, so the packet lists them instead of faxing those pages again.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: No recipient accepts a list of the documents they already have yet.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A fax service account or your own SIP trunk that sends faxes.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: The recipient accepts a list of the documents they already have; you record that on their page.

capabilities.name: Direct delivery
capabilities.sentence: Sends documents to verified partners over the internet instead of placing a fax call.
capabilities.example: A hospital that also runs Faxbot is your verified partner. A discharge summary to its fax number goes over the internet as the original file, with no fax call.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: A verified partner: another organization that runs Faxbot, added from its partner card and confirmed with a check fax.

capabilities.name: Sending together
capabilities.sentence: Sends several short faxes to the same number in one call, on a line that charges for each call.
capabilities.example: Five short faxes for the same lab within a few minutes go in one call instead of five, on a trunk that charges for each call.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On for 1 recipient who agreed.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Your own SIP trunk for sending, from a phone carrier or your phone system.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Trunk prices that charge for each call or bill whole minutes, so one call for several faxes costs less.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A recipient that agrees to receive several faxes in one call; you record that on their page.

capabilities.name: Fewer separator pages
capabilities.sentence: Marks each document in a shared call with an index page or a line on each page instead of a separator page.
capabilities.example: Three documents sent together to a lab start with one index page that lists them, instead of a separator page before each one.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: No recipient has agreed to an index page or page marks yet.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Your own SIP trunk for sending, from a phone carrier or your phone system.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Trunk prices that charge for each call or bill whole minutes, so one call for several faxes costs less.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: A recipient that shares calls and agrees to an index page or page marks; you record that on their page.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: For marks at the top of every page: your header text and sending number.

outcomes.title: Lower receiving and service costs
outcomes.sentence: Keep only the numbers, lines and plans you need, and turn away junk calls.

capabilities.name: Junk callers turned away
capabilities.sentence: Declines calls from blocked numbers before Faxbot answers, so they are never answered or received.
capabilities.example: A number keeps sending junk faxes at night. Once you block it, its calls are declined before Faxbot answers, so nothing is received or stored.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On for 1 number on your blocked list.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Faxes received over your own SIP trunk.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A number on your blocked list.
